item.title: Loveland to revamp some city departments in April – BizWest
item.description: A reorganization of some departments and staff positions in Loveland will begin in April, the city announced Friday.

item.title: University of Colorado offers to run NCAR if feds insist on restructuring – BizWest
item.description: If the Trump administration insists on restructuring the Boulder-based National Center for Atmospheric Research, the University of Colorado says it — along with several other public universities in the West — should be allowed to take over management of the weather-science institution.

item.title: Boys and Girls Clubs of Larimer County names 2026 Youths of the Year – BizWest
item.description: Boys & Girls Clubs of Larimer County has named its 2026 Youths of the Year.

item.title: CEOs on AI: ‘This is going to change everything’ – BizWest
item.description: From education to research and production, executives attending a BizWest CEO Roundtable on innovation this week agreed that artificial intelligence has turned their worlds upside down.

item.title: Judge denies mountain coaster appeal for more parking – BizWest
item.description: A district judge has upheld the December 2024 decision by the Board of Larimer County Commissioners that denied Mustang Mountain Coaster’s application to expand its parking lot in eastern Estes Park by 50 spaces.

item.title: 7 apartment buildings planned for Harmony Technology Park – BizWest
item.description: Seven three-story buildings holding a total of about 261 market-rate apartments could soon rise as part of the Harmony Technology Park in southeast Fort Collins.

item.title: Firestone’s pro soccer ambitions deflated – BizWest
item.description: Firestone town officials have issued a red card to a proposed stadium at Central Park, ending — for now, at least — a short-lived push to bring professional soccer back to Northern Colorado.

item.title: Raising Cane's opens Loveland location – BizWest
item.description: Baton Rouge, Louisiana-based Raising Cane’s, a 30-year-old chain that specializes in fried chicken fingers and crinkle-cut french fries, opened a Loveland location Monday.

item.title: Westminster to debut restaurant week in April – BizWest
item.description: Westminster’s first restaurant week, dubbed Westy Restaurant Week, will take place April 17-26.

item.title: Clinica Family Health & Wellness reveals 2025 data breach – BizWest
item.description: Clinica Family Health & Wellness recently informed patients that the organization, which merged with Mental Health Partners in 2024, was the target of a March 2025 data breach.
